CommunityApplications.Profile: Gym Note is a self-hosted, local-first workout tracker for personal or family use. It includes an exercise library with GIFs (bundled from the third-party hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset for personal, educational, and non-commercial use; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md), custom exercises, group/routine builders, fixed and rolling workout schedules, workout logging with PR tracking, body weight tracking, body-composition report scanning (OCR), weekly muscle heatmap, analytics, Excel export, multi-user support, backup/restore, offline-capable PWA install on mobile, and 11 UI languages. This is a personal project, shared as-is. For support, open an issue on the GitHub repository.
